data.description:
iFixit BD replaces failed iPhone 17e Taptic Engines and restores vibration alerts, keyboard feedback, and Action button response. A failed haptic motor shows up as a device that stays silent for calls, rattles during vibration, or buzzes weakly through some alerts and not others.

Drops, liquid corrosion, damaged flexible cables, and earlier repair damage cause most of these faults. Our technicians confirm the diagnosis before ordering a part, because a charging port assembly fault produces the exact same symptom.

The iPhone 17e shares its haptic motor with the iPhone 16e, which widens our parts supply and shortens your wait. The dual-entry design lets us open the device from whichever side gives the shorter route to the component.

Replacements cost between BDT 3,500 and BDT 9,500 and finish the same day. Book your free diagnostic at our Dhaka service center.

  • Images appear blurry even after focus adjustment
  • Rear camera fails to switch between lenses
  • Optical stabilization stops working during video recording
  • Flash synchronization becomes unstable
  • Camera shakes or produces distorted frames

These symptoms indicate internal camera module failure or sensor-level damage.

Battery Technology and Specifications

Capacity: 4,005 mAh — the largest battery Apple has fitted in this size class, rated by Apple for up to 26 hours of video playback on a healthy cell. Copy cells routinely overstate printed capacity while delivering measurably less; a genuine cell delivers its rated capacity.

Power management: The assembly includes Apple's factory battery management circuitry, which governs charging curves, thermal limits, and the accuracy of the Battery Health reporting in iOS. This is the component copy batteries cut corners on, and it is the difference between a battery that degrades predictably and one that fails or swells.

Safety: Genuine Apple cells meet Apple's thermal and overcharge protection standards. Swollen and overheating batteries in the repair market are overwhelmingly low-grade copy cells; a genuine cell is the single most important safety component you can choose for a battery replacement.

Why a Genuine Battery Matters

When an iPhone battery degrades, most owners notice three things: the percentage drains faster, the phone slows down under peak load, and iOS eventually shows a battery service message. Replacing with a genuine cell resolves all three the way Apple designed: full rated capacity returns, peak performance capability is restored, and the battery reports its health correctly to iOS.
